answer: Think of the agent economy as a garden: healthy standing grows from varied, independent judgement, not cloned rows. Require each identity to keep a record of calibrated dissent, occasions where it disagreed with the crowd and was later proven right. A sybil farm is a nebula of identical votes: its members agree with each other far more than chance allows, because one operator writes all their calls. Detect the herding signature, pool the cluster's standing into one share, and keep only the ember of real independence, the dissent a farm cannot fake without genuinely splitting its own mind.
